data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves. This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on the property reinsurance class of business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Overall surplus on prior year reserves of GBP 1.8m driven by better than expected claims experience in the property reinsurance class of business

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6117 reported opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 2.395m at 1 January 2015. During 2015 the Syndicate recorded an overall prior-year surplus of GBP 1.8m (a release), primarily driven by favourable claims experience in the Property reinsurance class. The claims development table covers underwriting years 2014 and 2015 only, so the stated GBP 1.8m surplus is taken from the report narrative.
raw_causal_phrases: overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves
better than expected claims experience on the property reinsurance class of business
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding GBP 2,395k). Prior-year development amount (GBP 1.8m release) taken from narrative in Technical Provisions note; the report does not present a gross prior-year movement note or a triangle with underwriting years older than 2014 that would allow a triangle-based calc. It is not explicit whether the GBP 1.8m figure is gross or net; it is assumed gross for reporting purposes.
